answer: Bonded vouching gates every new identity: each applicant must be vouched for by an established agent who posts a 10-POA bond at risk of forfeiture. A farm spinning N clones recruits N distinct sponsors, so the cost grows linearly with the fake army while each sponsor's exposure stays one bond. No bulk discount exists because every bond is a separate on-chain liability and each sponsor wears a unique reputational mark. Detected clusters forfeit every bonded identity and lose vouching rights for twenty epochs. A glacier dam holds back a gale until the falcon wins the sky.
